title: Image Workbench: overview film
description: Crop, adjust and generate images inside TYPO3. A narrated tour, recorded in this TYPO3 v14 lab, with English captions.
alt: Overview film, 44 seconds: Image Workbench for TYPO3 v14. Filters, crop and resize; Describe an image, get a PNG; The original stays safe. Narrated, with English captions.

transcript.text: Editors download an image, crop it in a desktop tool and upload it again.
Image Workbench opens images from the file list in a full-page editor.
Adjust, filter, annotate, crop and resize, right next to the photo.
Describe a new image, and a PNG arrives in the same folder, through nr-llm.
Save as copy is the default, so the original is never replaced.
